title: Scaffold: update requirements.txt with all 7 deps, verify src/config.yaml exists, ensure src/ and tests/ packages
acceptance_criteria: requirements.txt contains all 7 deps from spec §12: duckdb>=1.0, pyarrow>=14.0, yfinance>=0.2, pandas>=2.0, pandas-market-calendars>=4.0, pydantic>=2.0, pyyaml>=6.0. src/config.yaml already exists (user-defined, do NOT modify it). src/__init__.py and tests/__init__.py exist. pip install -r requirements.txt exits 0.

title: Implement config module: Pydantic nested models, validators, from_yaml loader in src/config.py
acceptance_criteria: src/config.py defines DatabaseConfig, IngestionConfig (with field_validator that uppercases+deduplicates tickers and exclude_tickers), ServerConfig (with field_validator for port 1-65535), LoggingConfig, ReportsConfig, and PipelineConfig (nested, with db_path property and from_yaml classmethod defaulting to 'src/config.yaml'). from_yaml('src/config.yaml') loads the user's actual config correctly: database.duckdb_dir == 'C:\Intel\parquet', database.duckdb_filename == 'stock_ingestion.duckdb', ingestion.tickers == ['AAPL','AVB','MSFT','NVDA'], server.flight_port == 8815, logging.log_file == 'C:\Intel\parquet\stock_ingestion.log', reports.report_dir == 'C:\Intel\parquet'. from_yaml('nonexistent.yaml') returns all defaults without error. python -c "from src.config import PipelineConfig; c = PipelineConfig.from_yaml('src/config.yaml'); assert c.database.duckdb_dir == 'C:\\Intel\\parquet'; assert c.ingestion.tickers == ['AAPL','AVB','MSFT','NVDA']; print('OK')" exits 0 with output 'OK'.

title: Challenger: independent config module variant in src/config_challenger.py
acceptance_criteria: src/config_challenger.py defines the same public API: PipelineConfig class with from_yaml classmethod and nested config objects (database, ingestion, server, logging, reports). Same validation behavior (tickers uppercased+deduplicated, port 1-65535). Implementation must be structurally different from src/config.py (e.g. manual YAML parsing + dataclasses instead of Pydantic, or different validator approach, or different class hierarchy). from_yaml('src/config.yaml') produces the same values as the executor's implementation. from_yaml('nonexistent.yaml') returns defaults. python -c "from src.config_challenger import PipelineConfig; c = PipelineConfig.from_yaml('src/config.yaml'); assert c.database.duckdb_dir == 'C:\\Intel\\parquet'; assert c.ingestion.tickers == ['AAPL','AVB','MSFT','NVDA']; print('OK')" exits 0 with output 'OK'.

title: Critic: test config validation, YAML loading, defaults, edge cases in tests/test_config.py
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_config.py is parametrized over BOTH src.config.PipelineConfig and src.config_challenger.PipelineConfig. Tests: (1) from_yaml('src/config.yaml') loads correctly with all user's values; (2) from_yaml('nonexistent.yaml') returns all defaults; (3) tickers are uppercased (e.g. input 'aapl' -> 'AAPL'); (4) tickers are deduplicated (e.g. ['AAPL','AAPL','MSFT'] -> ['AAPL','MSFT']); (5) port out of range (0 or 65536) raises ValueError; (6) empty tickers list -> []; (7) nested attribute access works (config.database.duckdb_dir, config.ingestion.tickers, config.server.flight_host, config.logging.log_file, config.reports.report_dir); (8) db_path property joins duckdb_dir + duckdb_filename. All tests use the real src/config.yaml for loading tests and synthetic YAML strings for validation tests. python -m pytest tests/test_config.py -v exits 0 with all tests passing. Critic pastes pytest exit code and per-test pass/fail summary into EVENTS.log.
